contextInfo: Company, store, user and device match the authenticated session.
single: Only this context is authorized by the session. Other companies and stores require server authorization.
notificationsInfo: No alert count is assumed. Company events require an authorized data source.
helpBody: Open areas from the menu. The logo returns to the menu without logging out.
posHelp: At the POS, finish or check pending operations before changing areas.
filesHelp: Save local working files before leaving. A local file is not an official company record.
noSecrets: Do not enter certificates, bank passwords or keys in this panel.
backupInfo: No connected source can confirm backups or restores. Existing tools do not prove a recent backup.
syncInfo: No integrated query for queues, conflicts or peers. Connection does not mean synchronization is complete.
note: Browser checks support the interface; server authorization remains mandatory.
integrationInfo: This panel shows known states. It does not store credentials or claim active integrations without confirmation.
checkingOnly: The test confirms only the local server HTTP response.
helpPermissions: Only modules and actions allowed for your session are shown.
tokenInfo: Changing companies must renew the session and clear prior data; changing a code on screen does not grant access.
